title: Change Data Capture
summary: CDC streams database changes from WAL/binlog into downstream systems without dual writes. It powers caches, search indexes, analytics, and event-driven integrations — with ordering, schema, and backfill challenges.

sections.title: Why CDC beats dual writes
paragraphs: Application dual writes to DB and queue fail partially. CDC treats the database transaction log as the source of truth and emits ordered change events.
Debezium, AWS DMS, and native logical decoding plug into WAL/binlog/oplog. Consumers rebuild read models asynchronously.

sections.title: Semantics and ordering
paragraphs: Events usually carry before/after images, transaction ids, and log coordinates (LSN). Ordering is per partition/key — not global across shards.
Deletes, schema changes, and toasted/large values need explicit handling. Snapshot + streaming backfill must be coordinated to avoid gaps/duplicates.

sections.title: Operational concerns
paragraphs: Log retention must exceed consumer lag. Long downtime means re-snapshot. Privileges for replication slots are sensitive.
Downstream must be idempotent; at-least-once is the common delivery mode.

sections.title: Design patterns
paragraphs: Use CDC for search indexing, cache hydration, and analytics lakes. Avoid using CDC as a hidden microservice choreography bus without schema contracts.

deepDive.title: Change Data Capture — Operations
paragraphs: Operating Change Data Capture in production means defining SLIs before tuning knobs, knowing amplification costs, and rehearsing failure modes.
Prefer reversible changes, feature flags, and canaries. Measure p50/p99 and error rate under load that matches production skew.
bullets: Define capacity from the scarcest resource
Keep rollback cheaper than forward repair when possible

deepDive.title: Change Data Capture — Failure modes
paragraphs: Common failures around Change Data Capture include overload, partial dependency outages, and silent correctness bugs that pass happy-path tests.
Inject faults in staging: latency, loss, clock skew, and disk full. Verify alerts fire and degradation is intentional.

expert.title: Change Data Capture — Expert notes
paragraphs: At the expert level, Change Data Capture intersects multi-region consistency, cost envelopes, and organizational constraints (team ownership, on-call load).
Write down the non-goals. Many outages come from optimizing a metric that was never the product requirement.

pitfalls: Silent consumer lag during peak writes
keyTakeaways: CDC makes the transaction log the integration backbone
Treat lag as a first-class SLO
whyItMatters: Modern data platforms and event-driven designs increasingly start from CDC rather than fragile dual writes.
reflectionQuestions: Which dual writes in your system could become CDC streams?
numbersToKnow: Know your p99 latency budget before adding hops
Peak load ≠ average load — plan headroom (often 2–3×)
Cross-region RTT is often ~50–150ms one way
